title: Automated Detection of Lumbosacral Transitional Vertebrae on Plain Lumbar Radiographs Using a Deep Learning Model.
summary: Deep-learning model detects lumbosacral transitional vertebrae from lumbar radiographs. Results evaluates image detections against expert/radiographic labels on test data; narrow diagnostic imaging claim. The result is reported in Journal of Clinical Medicine. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
